source.provenance: two exact user-supplied published file names and original schema; direct second Dryad byte download not independently verified
source.measurement_grain: fruit count per experimental plant × accession/watering mean seeds per fruit (same study, NOT plant-level directly counted seeds)

qc.source_selection_warning: accessions without both seed-per-fruit water calibrations have much higher zero-fruit incidence (64% vs 7.9%); cannot infer full 38 accession population

frozen_test.outcome_primary: raw estimated seeds, fruit × accession-and-watering mean seeds per fruit
frozen_test.outcome_sensitivity: sqrt estimated seeds and sqrt fruit on same 33 accessions
frozen_test.P0: training mean response within each four water × microbe action
frozen_test.P1: P0 + accession mean residual shrunken with k_accession=10
frozen_test.P2c_primary: P1 + accession×action residual shrinkage k_action=10, accession-level training-frequency-weighted effect centered to zero
frozen_test.P2u_legacy: P1 + uncentered accession×action residual (may repair accession intercept)
frozen_test.holdout: five entire experimental racks, no training row sharing with heldout rack
frozen_test.claim_gate_prediction: MSE(P1)-MSE(P2c)>0; all five racks nonnegative; accession bootstrap lower>0; at least 3/4 action contexts positive
frozen_test.claim_gate_choice: average raw estimated seed utility gain>0; accession bootstrap lower>0; at least 3/5 rack gains positive
frozen_test.bootstrap: conditional 2000 repeated accession-cluster draws of fixed heldout predictions, not independent experiment
frozen_test.cost_model: all four experimental interventions treated as equally costly for retrospective comparison only

primary_raw_seed_prediction.reason: one negative heldout rack; one negative action is tolerated by the predefined 3/4 threshold but is a robustness warning

uncentered_legacy_raw_seed_prediction.status: legacy fitted predictor gains may partly capture accession baseline correction rather than pure relative action response

sqrt_seed_prediction_sensitivity.caveat: square-root-scale estimate uses water-specific seed-per-fruit source calibration measured within same experiment

matched_fruit_prediction_sensitivity.caveat: exactly same 33 accessions and 659 fruit records as reconstructed seed outcome; cannot attribute transformed seed gain solely to intrinsic fruit response

raw_estimated_seed_action_decision.interpretation: a slightly positive sample average with interval spanning zero; not evidence that finer accession-specific action policy improves seed production

validation.independently_implemented_local_calculat: Pandas groupby/vectorized heldout centered response and panel choice matched standard-library source calculations to reported precision
